def fill_zeros_by_diagonal_majority(grid, r0=0, c0=0, anti=True):
    """Fill zero cells with the most common nonzero value on their diagonal (anti-diagonal if anti, else main), counting only cells at row>=r0 and col>=c0; zeros with no such diagonal values stay 0."""
    from collections import Counter as _C
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    key = (lambda i, j: i + j) if anti else (lambda i, j: i - j)
    diag = {}
    for i in range(r0, h):
        for j in range(c0, w):
            if grid[i][j] != 0:
                diag.setdefault(key(i, j), _C())[grid[i][j]] += 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == 0 and key(i, j) in diag:
                out[i][j] = diag[key(i, j)].most_common(1)[0][0]
    return out
